MyCase connector is one-way; connection requires the documented firm-preferences/billing/payment permission. Practice areas match by name, missing matches stay unset. LEAP Integration · 2026-04-24

LEAP US requires Matter Numbering enabled. State selects available Matter Types; practice-area and custom mappings are type-scoped. Files and note-comments use separate named folders. CARET connection requires an administrator. Practice areas/users and In Charge, Billing and Originating Attorney fields require mappings. Sync-only differs from hiring conversion. Smokeball Integration · 2026-03-16

Smokeball connector is one-way with optional files/notes, practice-area mapping and matter-type-scoped custom fields. Compatible types permit text fallback. Sync-only differs from conversion/hired/date, and resync is described as updating an existing matter. No relationship toggle is described; absence is not a product-wide exclusion.

Rocket Matter Integration · 2026-03-16

Rocket Matter connector is one-way, with optional files/notes, immutable standard and contact/matter custom mappings. Typed compatibility permits text fallback. Sync-only differs from conversion/hired/date; resync claims updating existing matter. No general reverse behavior or relationship support is established here.

It describes one-way matter/contact mapping, practice areas, optional notes, conversion versus sync-only and existing-matter resync. It does not establish document transfer or Converted Date behavior.

Initial/final negotiated values remain distinct. Doc Generation

Static-section DocGen exposes static fields and collection aggregates; per-item buttons expose the selected collection item. Lists require Collection Exports/Fusion. DOCX/XLSX/PDF, multi-template selection and shared tag/folder settings are described. Folder templates can create missing paths. Project-type-specific replacement codes, formatting/MERGEFIELD, unknown-code failures and250fillable-PDF-field limit apply. PDF mapping uses one code without braces or extra text. Rename/version/update/replace differ; generated fillable fields remain editable unless flattened. Date-format sample/output inconsistencies retained for testing.

API General Q&A

API guidance distinguishes supported public endpoints from unstable internal requests, additive/breaking changes and project-scoped testing. PAT expiry is to the minute; expired tokens need replacement. No documented DocGen or SMS-send endpoint; Mass DocGen and third-party SMS/note logging are alternatives. Create Note cannot designate native phone/email type; a tag is only a workaround. Obsolete fields can still update; custom contact metadata/selectors and valid dates apply, with date clearing/NULL unsupported. Collection lookup requires project type/section selector and IsCollection. Sample custom-field JSON has punctuation defect; do not copy as executable code.

Matter Vs. Contact Type Automations · 2026-01-06Matter status is an additional eligibility gate. Matter workflows can use primary-contact assets;contact workflows cannot use matter-only assets. Target type cannot be changed after creation. Leads are documented as matters.
Force Exiting from an Automation · 2026-03-23Force exit during a delay stops subsequent steps and is logged. Prior messages/actions are not undone. A later run requires explicit restart. The video describes an approximate30-second pre-fire interval; it is not a guaranteed undo period.

AT-0676 — Save draft separately from publication

As the attorney, I need draft website changes and public availability controlled separately, with an exportable exit record.
